title: चतुर्विंशत्यधिकत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 324 · King Vasu and the sages

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks how the king Vasu, a devotee of the Lord, fell and entered a cleft of the earth. Bhishma tells how the sages cursed him when he took the side of the gods in a quarrel over the sacrifice, and how, even so, he honoured Vishvaksena and recited the prayer that came from Narayana's mouth.
summary.kn: ಭಗವದ್ಭಕ್ತ ರಾಜ ವಸು ಏಕೆ ಬಿದ್ದು ಭೂಮಿಯ ಬಿರುಕು ಸೇರಿದನೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಯಜ್ಞದ ವಿವಾದದಲ್ಲಿ ದೇವತೆಗಳ ಪಕ್ಷ ವಹಿಸಿದಾಗ ಋಷಿಗಳು ಶಪಿಸಿದರು, ಆದರೂ ವಿಷ್ವಕ್ಸೇನನನ್ನು ಪೂಜಿಸಿ ನಾರಾಯಣನ ಮುಖದಿಂದ ಬಂದ ಜಪ ಮಾಡಿದನೆಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि भगवद्भक्त राजा वसु क्यों गिरा और पृथ्वी के विवर में गया। भीष्म बताते हैं कि यज्ञ विवाद में देवताओं का पक्ष लेने पर ऋषियों ने शाप दिया, फिर भी उसने विष्वक्सेन की पूजा की और नारायण के मुख से निकले जप का पाठ किया।
summary.te: భగవద్భక్తుడైన రాజు వసువు ఎందుకు పడి భూమి బిలంలో ప్రవేశించాడని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. యజ్ఞ వివాదంలో దేవతల పక్షం తీసుకోగా ఋషులు శపించారని, అయినా విష్వక్సేనుని పూజించి నారాయణ ముఖం నుండి వచ్చిన జపం చేశాడని భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: இறைவனின் அடியார் மன்னன் வசு ஏன் வீழ்ந்து பூமியின் பிளவில் நுழைந்தான் என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, வேள்வி வாதத்தில் தேவர் பக்கம் நின்றதால் முனிவர்கள் சபித்தனர், ஆயினும் அவன் விஷ்வக்சேனனை வணங்கி நாராயணன் வாயிலிருந்து வந்த ஜபத்தைச் செய்தான் என்று பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: ഭഗവാന്റെ ഭക്തനായ വസു രാജാവ് എങ്ങനെ വീണ് ഭൂമിയുടെ വിള്ളലിൽ പ്രവേശിച്ചുവെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. യജ്ഞത്തെച്ചൊല്ലിയുള്ള തർക്കത്തിൽ ദേവന്മാരുടെ പക്ഷം ചേർന്നപ്പോൾ മുനിമാർ ശപിച്ചതും, എങ്കിലും വിശ്വക്സേനനെ ആദരിച്ച് നാരായണന്റെ മുഖത്തുനിന്ന് വന്ന പ്രാർത്ഥന അദ്ദേഹം ഉരുവിട്ടതും ഭീഷ്മർ വിവരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.324; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
यदा भक्तो भगवत आसीद्राजा महावसुः ।
किमर्थं स परिभ्रष्टो विवेश विवरं भुवः ॥

meaning.en: When King Mahavasu was a devotee of the Blessed One, why did he fall and enter a cleft in the earth?

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
ऋषीणां चैव संवादं त्रिदशानां च भारत ॥

meaning.en: On this too they cite an ancient account, the conversation of sages and the gods, Bharata.

verses.text:
अजेन यष्टव्यमिति देवाः प्राहुर्द्विजोत्तमान् ।
स च छागो ह्यजो ज्ञेयो नान्यः पशुरिति स्थितिः ॥

meaning.en: The gods told the best of brahmins: "One should sacrifice with aja." And aja is to be understood as a goat; no other animal is meant, it is established.

verses.text: ऋषय ऊचुः

meaning.en: The sages said:

verses.text:
बीजैर्यज्ञेषु यष्टव्यमिति वै वैदिकी श्रुतिः ।
अजसंज्ञानि बीजानि छागं न घ्नन्तुमर्हथ ॥

meaning.en: "The Vedic text says, 'One should sacrifice with seeds in sacrifices.' Seeds are called aja; you should not kill a goat.

verses.text:
नैष धर्मः सतां देवा यत्र वध्येत वै पशुः ।
इदं कृतयुगं श्रेष्ठं कथं वध्येत वै पशुः ॥

meaning.en: This is not the dharma of the good, gods, that an animal be killed. This is the best age, the Krita; how can an animal be killed?"

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
तेषां संवदतामेवमृषीणां विबुधैः सह ।
मार्गागतो नृपश्रेष्ठस्तं देशं प्राप्तवान्वसुः ।
अन्तरिक्षचरः श्रीमान्समग्रबलवाहनः ॥

meaning.en: While the sages and the gods were arguing thus, the best of kings, Vasu, came along the road and reached that place, traveling through the sky, resplendent with his whole army and vehicles.

verses.text:
तं दृष्ट्वा सहसायान्तं वसुं ते त्वन्तरिक्षगम् ।
ऊचुर्द्विजातयो देवानेष छेत्स्यति संशयम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Vasu suddenly coming through the sky, the twice-born said to the gods, "He will cut this doubt.

verses.text:
यज्वा दानपतिः श्रेष्ठः सर्वभूतहितप्रियः ।
कथं स्विदन्यथा ब्रूयाद्वाक्यमेष महान्वसुः ॥

meaning.en: A sacrificer, lord of gifts, best of men, who loves the welfare of all beings: how could this great Vasu say otherwise?"

verses.text:
एवं ते संविदं कृत्वा विबुधा ऋषयस्तथा ।
अपृच्छन्सहसाभ्येत्य वसुं राजानमन्तिकात् ॥

meaning.en: Having agreed thus, the gods and sages suddenly approached King Vasu and asked him.

verses.text:
भो राजन्केन यष्टव्यमजेनाहोस्विदौषधैः ।
एतन्नः संशयं छिन्धि प्रमाणं नो भवान्मतः ॥

meaning.en: "King, with what should one sacrifice, with aja or with herbs? Cut this doubt of ours; you are accepted by us as authority."

verses.text:
स तान्कृताञ्जलिर्भूत्वा परिपप्रच्छ वै वसुः ।
कस्य वः को मतः पक्षो ब्रूत सत्यं समागताः ॥

meaning.en: Vasu, folding his hands, asked them, "Which side is whose? Tell me the truth, gathered here."

verses.text: ऋषय ऊचुः

meaning.en: The sages said:

verses.text:
धान्यैर्यष्टव्यमित्येष पक्षोऽस्माकं नराधिप ।
देवानां तु पशुः पक्षो मतो राजन्वदस्व नः ॥

meaning.en: "Our side, lord of men, is that one should sacrifice with grains. The gods' side is held to be the animal. Tell us, king."

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
देवानां तु मतं ज्ञात्वा वसुना पक्षसंश्रयात् ।
छागेनाजेन यष्टव्यमेवमुक्तं वचस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Knowing the gods' view and taking their side, Vasu then said, "One should sacrifice with a goat."

verses.text:
कुपितास्ते ततः सर्वे मुनयः सूर्यवर्चसः ।
ऊचुर्वसुं विमानस्थं देवपक्षार्थवादिनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then all those sages, bright as the sun, enraged, said to Vasu, who stood in his aerial chariot and spoke in favor of the gods' position:

verses.text:
सुरपक्षो गृहीतस्ते यस्मात्तस्माद्दिवः पत ।
अद्य प्रभृति ते राजन्नाकाशे विहता गतिः ।
अस्मच्छापाभिघातेन महीं भित्त्वा प्रवेक्ष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: "Because you have taken the gods' side, fall from heaven. From today, king, your movement in the sky is obstructed; struck by our curse, you will split the earth and enter it."

verses.text:
ततस्तस्मिन्मुहूर्तेऽथ राजोपरिचरस्तदा ।
अधो वै संबभूवाशु भूमेर्विवरगो नृपः ।
स्मृतिस्त्वेनं न प्रजहौ तदा नारायणाज्ञया ॥

meaning.en: At that moment King Uparichara quickly went down, into a cleft of the earth; but by Narayana's command, his memory did not leave him.

verses.text:
देवास्तु सहिताः सर्वे वसोः शापविमोक्षणम् ।
चिन्तयामासुरव्यग्राः सुकृतं हि नृपस्य तत् ॥

meaning.en: But all the gods together, undisturbed, considered how to release Vasu from the curse, for that king had done them a good deed.

verses.text:
अनेनास्मत्कृते राज्ञा शापः प्राप्तो महात्मना ।
अस्य प्रतिप्रियं कार्यं सहितैर्नो दिवौकसः ॥

meaning.en: "This great king received the curse for our sake; we heavenly beings together must do him a favor in return."

verses.text:
इति बुद्ध्या व्यवस्याशु गत्वा निश्चयमीश्वराः ।
ऊचुस्तं हृष्टमनसो राजोपरिचरं तदा ॥

meaning.en: Having resolved this by thought, the lords went to him with delighted minds and said to King Uparichara:

verses.text:
ब्रह्मण्यदेवं त्वं भक्तः सुरासुरगुरुं हरिम् ।
कामं स तव तुष्टात्मा कुर्याच्छापविमोक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: "You are a devotee of Hari, god of brahmins, teacher of gods and asuras; may he, with a satisfied heart, do the freeing from the curse as he wishes.

verses.text:
मानना तु द्विजातीनां कर्तव्या वै महात्मनाम् ।
अवश्यं तपसा तेषां फलितव्यं नृपोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: But the great brahmins must be honored, best of kings; their austerity must surely bear fruit.

verses.text:
यतस्त्वं सहसा भ्रष्ट आकाशान्मेदिनीतलम् ।
एकं त्वनुग्रहं तुभ्यं दद्मो वै नृपसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Since you fell suddenly from the sky to the surface of the earth, we give you one favor, best of kings.

verses.text:
यावत्त्वं शापदोषेण कालमासिष्यसेऽनघ ।
भूमेर्विवरगो भूत्वा तावन्तं कालमाप्स्यसि ।
यज्ञेषु सुहुतां विप्रैर्वसोर्धारां महात्मभिः ॥

meaning.en: For as long as you remain under the fault of the curse, blameless one, living in the cleft of the earth, for that time you will receive the stream of Vasu, well offered by great brahmins in sacrifices.

verses.text:
प्राप्स्यसेऽस्मदनुध्यानान्मा च त्वां ग्लानिरास्पृशेत् ।
न क्षुत्पिपासे राजेन्द्र भूमेश्छिद्रे भविष्यतः ॥

meaning.en: You will receive it by our contemplation, and no weariness will touch you; hunger and thirst will not be in the cleft of the earth, king of kings.

verses.text:
वसोर्धारानुपीतत्वात्तेजसाप्यायितेन च ।
स देवोऽस्मद्वरात्प्रीतो ब्रह्मलोकं हि नेष्यति ॥

meaning.en: By drinking Vasu's stream and being nourished by its energy, that god will, through our boon, be pleased and go to the world of Brahma."

verses.text:
एवं दत्त्वा वरं राज्ञे सर्वे तत्र दिवौकसः ।
गताः स्वभवनं देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः ॥

meaning.en: Having given this boon to the king, all the gods there and the sages rich in austerity went to their homes.

verses.text:
चक्रे च सततं पूजां विष्वक्सेनाय भारत ।
जप्यं जगौ च सततं नारायणमुखोद्गतम् ॥

meaning.en: He constantly worshiped Vishvaksena, Bharata, and constantly sang the prayer that came from Narayana's mouth.

verses.text:
तत्रापि पञ्चभिर्यज्ञैः पञ्चकालानरिंदम ।
अयजद्धरिं सुरपतिं भूमेर्विवरगोऽपि सन् ॥

meaning.en: Even there, in the cleft of the earth, with five sacrifices at the five times, subduer of enemies, he worshiped Hari, lord of gods.

verses.text:
ततोऽस्य तुष्टो भगवान्भक्त्या नारायणो हरिः ।
अनन्यभक्तस्य सतस्तत्परस्य जितात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Then the blessed Narayana Hari, pleased with the devotion of that exclusively devoted, self-controlled man, intent on him,

verses.text:
वरदो भगवान्विष्णुः समीपस्थं द्विजोत्तमम् ।
गरुत्मन्तं महावेगमाबभाषे स्मयन्निव ॥

meaning.en: the blessed boon-giving Vishnu spoke, as if smiling, to the best of birds, Garuda, standing near, of great speed:

verses.text:
द्विजोत्तम महाभाग गम्यतां वचनान्मम ।
सम्राड्राजा वसुर्नाम धर्मात्मा मां समाश्रितः ॥

meaning.en: "Best of birds, greatly fortunate, go at my word. King Vasu, the righteous emperor who took refuge in me,

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणानां प्रकोपेन प्रविष्टो वसुधातलम् ।
मानितास्ते तु विप्रेन्द्रास्त्वं तु गच्छ द्विजोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: has entered the earth through the wrath of brahmins. Those chief brahmins have been honored; but you, best of birds, go.

verses.text:
भूमेर्विवरसंगुप्तं गरुडेह ममाज्ञया ।
अधश्चरं नृपश्रेष्ठं खेचरं कुरु माचिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Garuda, by my command, make that best of kings, now hidden below in a cleft of the earth, a sky-goer without delay."

verses.text:
गरुत्मानथ विक्षिप्य पक्षौ मारुतवेगवान् ।
विवेश विवरं भूमेर्यत्रास्ते वाग्यतो वसुः ॥

meaning.en: Then Garuda, swift as the wind, spread his wings and entered the cleft of the earth where Vasu sat, restraining his speech.

verses.text:
तत एनं समुत्क्षिप्य सहसा विनतासुतः ।
उत्पपात नभस्तूर्णं तत्र चैनममुञ्चत ॥

meaning.en: Then Vinata's son suddenly lifted him and flew quickly up into the sky, and released him there.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते संजज्ञे राजोपरिचरः पुनः ।
सशरीरो गतश्चैव ब्रह्मलोकं नृपोत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: At that moment King Uparichara was born again, and the best of kings went in his body to the world of Brahma.

verses.text:
एवं तेनापि कौन्तेय वाग्दोषाद्देवताज्ञया ।
प्राप्ता गतिरयज्वार्हा द्विजशापान्महात्मना ॥

meaning.en: Thus, son of Kunti, by a slip of speech and by the gods' command, that great soul reached a state unfit for a sacrificer, through the brahmins' curse.

verses.text:
केवलं पुरुषस्तेन सेवितो हरिरीश्वरः ।
ततः शीघ्रं जहौ शापं ब्रह्मलोकमवाप च ॥

meaning.en: Only because he had served the Lord, the person Hari, he soon shed the curse and gained the world of Brahma.

verses.text:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं ते भूता मानवा यथा ।
नारदोऽपि यथा श्वेतं द्वीपं स गतवानृषिः ।
तत्ते सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमना नृप ॥

meaning.en: All this I have told you, how those beings and men were, and how the sage Narada went to the White Island. I will tell you all that; listen with a single mind, king.
